title: Secret scanning
requirement: Stop credentials from entering commits and find leaked ones in history, with one scanner unless a second one adds a distinct, needed job.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Detection and false positives on a seeded corpus, pre-commit latency, and what a second scanner finds that the first misses.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
